description: Original transparent animation sheets copied unchanged; frame rectangles are metadata.

effects.prompt: Production asset for a realistic painted fantasy tactical strategy game. Create one genuinely transparent RGBA PNG animation sprite atlas, square image, exactly SIX equal columns by SIX equal rows: 36 equal square cells read left to right then top to bottom. Each cell contains ONE frame of the SAME spell effect: a compact upright funnel tornado of crimson magical wind, smoky burgundy and scarlet coils, thin glowing red magical threads and a few dark dust particles, clearly recognizable twisting funnel, dangerous fantasy blood magic, no blood splatter or gore. Not an icon grid of different designs: depict 36 consecutive phases of ONE seamless continuous LOOP, smoothly turning and billowing; last frame flows naturally into first, no sudden new shape, no camera changes. Keep fixed scale, position, ground center and elevated three-quarter battle camera throughout, complete effect inside each cell, broad empty transparent gutters on all four sides at least 15 percent of the cell. No characters, no buildings, no scenery, no ground plane, no ground shadow, no floor disk, no UI, no text, no numbers, no grid lines, no colored background, no checkerboard. Detailed brush painted realistic game VFX, excellent silhouette and readable at small battlefield size. Semi-transparent soft smoke edges are welcome, but background and inter-cell gutters must have alpha zero. Wide enough gutters that swirling blades/particles never cross cells. 1536x1536 square sheet.
